legend.en: At the opportune moment, Raven Guard infiltration units slip away from battle, only to relocate ready to strike the foe again.

when.en: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.

target.en: One unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit.

effect.en: Place your unit in strategic reserves.

legend.en: The Raven Guard are swift to exploit the movements of their foes, whether to pursue their prey and complete the kill or to make use of an opportunity to fade once more from sight.

when.en: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit.

effect.en: Your unit can make a normal move of: Up to D6". Or: If your unit is a PHOBOS/SCOUT SQUAD unit, up to 6".

legend.en: From darkness and obscuring cover, Raven Guard battle-brothers open fire as one, striking their unaware targets with precision fire.

when.en: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit that made an ingress move this turn is selected to shoot.

effect.en: Your unit’s ranged attacks have: +1 BS. +1 AP.

legend.en: The Raven Guard commonly utilise integral suppressors, flash-hiders and other technology to dampen weapon reports and conceal muzzle flare, enabling battle-brothers to fire on unsuspecting foes without giving away their positions.

when.en: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit has shot.

effect.en: Those attacks do not prevent your unit from being hidden.

legend.en: Retreating from the fight, these warriors lure their enemies on before swiftly turning the tables and hurling themselves into their now overextended foe.

target.en: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit.

effect.en: The tactical doctrine is active for your unit in addition to any other combat doctrine, until the start of your next Command phase.

legend.en: In a storm of blade thrusts and bludgeoning strikes, enemy champions and commanders are laid low, leaving their troops in leaderless disarray.

when.en: Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit is selected to fight.
